writer.name: 德米特里·达维多夫 Dmitrii Davydov

director.name: 德米特里·达维多夫 Dmitrii Davydov

introduction: Three old men live in an abandoned village cut off from the outside world and the passage of time. They spent their days drinking tea, smoking tobacco, and observing the desolate landscape. The course of their lives changes when the trio discovers a frozen boy in the river who decides to thaw and resurrect before their eyes granting each of them a miracle. Whether it was a guardian angel or the devil himself, his departure marks the beginning of the village's inevitable demise.
